description: Canonical RBAC permission codes for Income & Expense (Cambodia). Must match backend/internal/permissions and frontend/utils/permissions.ts

permissions.name: Manage Users
permissions.description: Manage user roles, passwords, and account activation

permissions.name: Manage Roles
permissions.description: Create, edit, and delete non-system roles

permissions.name: View Permission Codes
permissions.description: See the Permission Codes page with every permission in the system

permissions.name: Manage Categories
permissions.description: Create, edit, and deactivate income/expense categories

permissions.name: Manage Backups
permissions.description: Back up the database, send backups to Telegram, and restore from a backup

permissions.name: View Inventory
permissions.description: See products, stock levels and stock history of your branches

permissions.name: Manage Products
permissions.description: Create and edit products and product categories (shared by every branch)

permissions.name: Adjust Stock
permissions.description: Add, remove or count stock in your branches, with a reason

permissions.name: Create Sales
permissions.description: Record sales; their stock goes out right away

permissions.name: Void Sales
permissions.description: Void a sale and put its stock back

permissions.name: Edit Sales
permissions.description: Change a sale; its goods are put back and the new lines taken out of stock

permissions.name: Create Purchases
permissions.description: Record purchases from suppliers; stock goes in once approved

permissions.name: Approve Purchases
permissions.description: Approve or reject purchases; approved purchases add stock

permissions.name: Void Purchases
permissions.description: Void a purchase and take its stock back out

permissions.name: Edit Purchases
permissions.description: Change a pending purchase (an approved one also needs Approve Purchases)

permissions.name: View Inventory Expenses
permissions.description: See inventory expenses of your branches

permissions.name: View Agents
permissions.description: See agents and the groups they are in

permissions.name: Manage Agents
permissions.description: Add and edit agents and their currency

permissions.name: Manage Group Agent Assignments
permissions.description: Make titled groups of agents with their rates; update, turn off or delete them

permissions.name: View Win/Lose
permissions.description: See the weekly win/lose entered for your groups

permissions.name: Enter Win/Lose
permissions.description: Enter a week's win/lose and commission for your groups (once a week)

permissions.name: Correct Win/Lose
permissions.description: Change a week already saved, with a reason (kept in the audit log)

permissions.name: View Win/Lose Reports
permissions.description: The weekly report and the group summary for your groups, one group at a time

permissions.name: View Consolidated Win/Lose
permissions.description: Combined totals across all your groups

permissions.name: Finalize Weekly Settlements
permissions.description: Finalize or reopen a group's week; a finalized week can't be changed
